[liquid_glass_widgets] LiquidGlassBlendGroup could not find an InheritedGeometryRenderLink in the widget tree.

This happens when GlassQuality.premium is used outside of a LiquidGlassLayer (or AdaptiveLiquidGlassLayer).

To fix this, either:
  • Wrap the widget in a LiquidGlassLayer / AdaptiveLiquidGlassLayer, OR
  • Set useOwnLayer: true on your GlassButton / AdaptiveGlass, which provisions its own layer automatically.

Example:
  GlassButton(
    quality: GlassQuality.premium,
    useOwnLayer: true, // ← add this
    ...
  )
Either trigger or triggerBuilder must be provided
GlassAdaptiveScopeData.of() was called on a context that does not have a GlassAdaptiveScope ancestor. Make sure GlassAdaptiveScope is placed above this widget in the tree.
GlassBottomBar requires at least one tab
GlassSearchableBottomBar requires at least one tab
GlassTab must have either an icon or label
LiquidGlassLayer requires Impeller. No glass effect will be rendered on this platform.
No GlassTheme found in context. Wrap your app with GlassTheme to provide theme configuration.
No liquid glass renderer found in context. Make sure to wrap your liquid glass widgets in a LiquidGlassLayer.
